newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan cuts fuel oil bunker price by $3 per tonne.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan cuts fuel oil bunker price by $3 per tonne.

text.p: Taiwan's Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has reduced its spot and term prices of bunker fuel effective November 6, a company statement said on Wednesday.

Posted prices for 180-, 280- and 380-centistoke bunker fuel delivered at the ports of Keelung, Hualien, Taichung and Suao were decreased by $3.00 per tonne, to $138. Term prices were also down by $3.00 to $135 per tonne.
Spot and term bunker C grade was also cut by $3.00, to $136 and $133 respectively. CPC is state owned and the country's sole supplier of bunker fuels. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703080)
